description: Single committed, version-controlled artifact provisioning the daily Session_Close Scheduler_Job that triggers the Cloud_Run_Job (spec Req 5.4).

commands.command: gcloud scheduler jobs create http scheduled-daily-run-session-close --schedule='0 17 * * 1-5' --time-zone=America/New_York --uri=https://europe-west1-run.googleapis.com/v2/projects/trade-assistant-508806/locations/europe-west1/jobs/scheduled-daily-run:run --http-method=POST --oauth-service-account-email=scheduler-invoker@trade-assistant-508806.iam.gserviceaccount.com --max-retry-attempts=3 --project=trade-assistant-508806 --location=europe-west1
